# Operations Audit

## Purpose
Assess the state of the Operations department in the whole system: how well web data ops, sales, and automation hold together, and where they are weak.

## Scope
- Web data ops and scraping
- Sales pipeline and negotiation
- Workflow automation
- Data quality and source tracing
- Handoffs between ops, product, and growth

## What is in place
- [ ] Workflow that traces every data row back to its source page
- [ ] Sales pipeline where every stage has evidence
- [ ] Negotiation positions recorded with reasons and BATNA
- [ ] Automation workflows tested end to end before use
- [ ] Record of ops workflows, pipelines, and data sources in one place

## Gaps
- [ ] Data rows with no traceable source
- [ ] Pipeline stages with no evidence behind them
- [ ] Negotiations with no recorded position or fallback
- [ ] Automations running untested or unmonitored
- [ ] Ops knowledge living in scattered notes

## Next steps
- Pick the highest priority gap and name its owner
- Add or fix the missing agent, skill, command, or workflow for that gap
- Run the new piece on a real data pull or sales step and check the result against evidence
- Record the decision and the outcome in the decision log
- Repeat for the next gap
- Share the finished audit and the changes with the people who need them, so the work reaches distribution
